### Example 1: Update a linux profile SSH creds
```powershell
Update-ZNSettingsLinuxProfileSshCredentials -ProfileId l:c:LmOwDgds -SshCredentialsPassword "newpassword" -SshCredentialsPrivateKey "-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY----------END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----" -SshCredentialsUsername "zn-admin"
```

```output

```

This cmdlet updates a linux profile SSH credentials.
